about: Programs, companies and channels for IIT students graduating in 2027 who want a job in Japan with English only. Hand-maintained: every row was read on the official page on the date in `checked`. fetch_japan.py turns this into data/programs.csv and the page.

fields.english_only: yes = Japanese not required | partly = depends on the role, some need none | taught = not needed to register, taught free before you join | no = Japanese required
fields.fits_2027: yes | partly | no: can someone graduating from an IIT in mid-2027 take it

programs.name: New-grad engineer intake, 2028 joiners (Term 1)
programs.language_note: Japanese 'Not required' (business English) for: Cloud Platform Software Engineer, AI & Data Data Engineer, Cloud Platform Data Engineer, AI Engineer, Research Scientist. Rakuten Payment Software Engineer: 'Not required to Business Level'. The rest need conversational to business Japanese.

programs.pay: From JPY 370,000 a month, including fixed overtime
programs.how: Apply on the 2028 entry portal; about one hour online coding test after document screening; interviews in English.

programs.deadline_note: Same Term 1 window as the engineer intake
